title: vendors
description: Shared by Inventory (an item is filed against a vendor) and Maintenance (work orders and bills). The prototype also keeps one "Company Issued" placeholder vendor per accessory; in the model these are a flag, not rows (TO CONFIRM).

name.description: Vendor name ("Comdata"). Required on Add Vendor.

categoryId.description: → `inventory_categories._id`. Add Vendor files new vendors under "Others".

status.description: Not editable in the UI today (TO CONFIRM).

email.description: Validated as an email when present.

country.description: Stored as the full name (the edit dialog writes "USA" today).

state.description: US state / DC or Canadian province code.

companyIssued.description: true = not a supplier (company-issued accessories). Hidden from vendor lists and pickers.

deletedAt.description: Soft delete; items and orders keep their vendorId.

createdAt.description: Set by the server on insert.

updatedAt.description: Set by the server on every write.
